map.L10 指同一批轴承中 90% 在疲劳剥落前能达到或超过的寿命（10% 失效寿命: L10 means the life that 90% of a batch of bearings can reach or exceed before fatigue spalling (10% failure life); it is a baseline for selection comparison, not a guaranteed life; actual life is also affected by lubrication, contamination and installation accuracy.
map.精度保持寿命为什么可以高于 L10？: Why can accuracy-holding life be higher than L10?
map.高精度等级（P2 因子 1.5）与良好润滑（喷射 1.5）会延长精度保持能力，使: High accuracy grade (P2 factor 1.5) and good lubrication (injection 1.5) extend the accuracy-holding ability, making the converted value higher than L10; but once fatigue spalling occurs, accuracy is quickly lost, so the two should be viewed together.

map.基于 ISO 281 的 L10 额定寿命公式，结合精度等级因子（P0–P2）与: Based on the ISO 281 L10 rated life formula, combined with accuracy grade factor (P0-P2) and lubrication factor, and computing dn value from the entered bearing bore, gives fatigue life and accuracy-retention life of precision bearings.
map.💡 L10=(C/P)^p×10⁶/(60n)；精度因子：P4×1.2，P2×1: L10 = (C/P)^p x 1e6 / (60n); accuracy factor: P4 x 1.2, P2 x 1.5; accuracy-retention life = L10 x accuracy factor x lubrication factor; dn value = n x bearing bore d
map.算法：球轴承取 p=3，L10 转数 = (C/P)³×1e6；L10 小时 =: Algorithm: ball bearing p = 3, L10 revolutions = (C/P)^3 x 1e6; L10 hours = revolutions / (60 x speed); accuracy-retention life = L10 hours x grade factor x lubrication factor (P0 1.0, P6 1.05, P5 1.1, P4 1.2, P2 1.5; grease 0.8, oil bath 1.0, oil mist 1.3, injection 1.5); load ratio = P/C x 100%; dn value = speed x bearing bore d (mm); >=30000 h excellent, >=15000 h good, >=5000 h medium, otherwise poor (display bands, not acceptance criteria); load ratio >20% suggests a larger size, dn value >500000 is this page's high-speed lubrication guide line.
map.例：P4 精密级、脂润滑、C=20kN、P=3kN、5000rpm、内径 d=2: Example: P4 precision grade, grease, C=20 kN, P=3 kN, 5000 rpm, bore d=25 mm gives L10 revolutions 2.963e8, L10 life 987.7 h, accuracy-retention life 948.1 h (0.11 years), load ratio 15%, dn 125000, rated poor. With P2 grade, oil bath, C=30 kN, P=2 kN, 3000 rpm, bore d=25 mm: L10 life 18750 h, accuracy-retention life 28125 h (3.21 years), load ratio 6.7%, dn 75000, rated good.
map.精密轴承寿命计算器基于 ISO 281 的 L10 额定寿命公式，结合精度等级因: The precision bearing life calculator uses the ISO 281 L10 rated-life formula with accuracy grade factor (P0-P2), lubrication factor and dn value from the entered bearing bore to compute fatigue life and accuracy-retention life, supporting bearing selection for machine-tool spindles and precision instruments.
